description: Open a PRIVATE collection to the signed-in buyer, using the address and access code its photographer gave them — for example a wedding or client gallery whose pictures are also for sale. Afterwards search_images, get_image and list_collections include it for this buyer, and its images can be bought like any other. Use it only with a code the person gave you; never guess one. Requires sign-in.

access_code.description: The access code the photographer gave the person.

gallery.description: The gallery's address as the person has it, e.g. https://example.com/jane/smith-wedding, or "jane/smith-wedding".

name: unlock_collection
title: Unlock a private collection
